description: Na₂SO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Fddd space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to six equivalent O²⁻ atoms to form distorted NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with four equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids, corners with four equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra, edges with four equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one SO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.49 Å. S⁶⁺ is bonded to four equivalent O²⁻ atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with eight equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids. All S-O bond lengths are 1.48 Å. O²⁻ is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and one S⁶⁺ atom.
